findings.description: The policy grants wildcard actions (ec2:*, s3:*, lambda:*, cloudwatch:*) on wildcard resources, which is effectively broad administrative access across multiple services. This violates the least privilege principle.

A static access key is created and attached to an IAM user. This creates a long-lived credential that persists until manually rotated and is a recurring source of credential compromise, instead of using temporary credentials or federation.
